settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.resetBody: Best score, runs and deliveries will be set to zero.

tutorial.step1: Units of four colours roll in from the top and drive down. The glyph on a unit — circle, square, triangle or diamond — matches the gate of its colour.
tutorial.step2: Drag a unit to draw its path: it follows the line and erases it behind. Lead the line into its own gate — the route docks and you can lift your finger. A new line on a unit replaces the old one.
tutorial.step3: Two units touching or a wrong gate ends the run. A red ring with "!" warns when units get too close.
tutorial.step4: +10 for every unit delivered. The more you deliver, the faster they go and the more often they appear. Once per run you can continue after a mistake.
tutorial.step5: Hexagons appear on the field — drive a unit through one. Freeze stops everyone for 3 s, Shield forgives one collision, ×2 doubles points for 10 s, Autopilot drives the unit to its gate.
